title: Private S3 Access from a VPC
summary: Build a private path from multi-AZ subnets to Amazon S3 using a gateway VPC endpoint, least-privilege IAM, and CloudWatch verification.

objectives.title: Author a least-privilege IAM role for private S3 reads
Place workloads in multi-AZ private subnets
Create a private encrypted S3 bucket with Block Public Access
Route private subnet S3 traffic through a gateway VPC endpoint

skipGate.prompt: Write a gateway endpoint policy that allows s3:GetObject only when aws:SourceVpce matches the lab endpoint, and explain why a NAT gateway is unnecessary for S3-only private workloads.

objectives.title: Verify GetObject over the private path with CloudWatch evidence

steps.title: Create a least-privilege lab role
steps.description: In IAM, create academy-s3-reader. Attach an inline policy that allows s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN and s3:GetObject on object ARNs only. Leave AdministratorAccess detached.
steps.alt: IAM create-role form with scoped S3 read actions highlighted before submit. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Create a least-privilege lab role.
steps.cliFallback: aws iam create-role --role-name academy-s3-reader --assume-role-policy-document file://ec2-trust.json && aws iam put-role-policy --role-name academy-s3-reader --policy-name s3-read --policy-document file://s3-read.json

steps.title: Confirm the role ARN without exposing account secrets
steps.description: After creation, record the role name and redacted ARN. Treat the 12-digit account id as sensitive and keep it masked in every instructional screenshot.
steps.alt: IAM success banner with redacted role ARN. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Confirm the role ARN without exposing account secrets.
steps.cliFallback: aws iam get-role --role-name academy-s3-reader --query Role.Arn --output text

steps.title: Create multi-AZ private subnets
steps.description: Create lab-vpc (10.20.0.0/16) with private subnets in two Availability Zones. Do not add a 0.0.0.0/0 route to an internet gateway on these route tables.
steps.alt: VPC subnet table showing two private subnets and no IGW default route. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Create multi-AZ private subnets.
steps.cliFallback: aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.20.0.0/16 && aws ec2 create-subnet --vpc-id vpc-lab --cidr-block 10.20.1.0/24 --availability-zone us-east-1a

steps.title: Create a private encrypted bucket
steps.description: Create academy-lab-artifacts with Block Public Access enabled, SSE-S3 default encryption, and bucket versioning on. Confirm the public-access settings panel before create.
steps.alt: S3 create-bucket wizard with Block Public Access and encryption enabled. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Create a private encrypted bucket.
steps.cliFallback: aws s3api create-bucket --bucket academy-lab-artifacts --region us-east-1 && aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket academy-lab-artifacts --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true

steps.title: Attach a gateway VPC endpoint for S3
steps.description: Create a Gateway endpoint for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3, associate both private route tables, and restrict the endpoint policy to the lab bucket ARN with aws:SourceVpc.
steps.alt: VPC endpoint create form with S3 gateway type and route-table associations. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Attach a gateway VPC endpoint for S3.
steps.cliFallback: aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-lab --service-name com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 --route-table-ids rtb-private-a rtb-private-b --policy-document file://vpce-s3.json

steps.title: Download an object over the private path
steps.description: From a private instance with the lab role, run aws s3 cp. There is no public IP and no NAT. Success proves prefix-list routing through the gateway endpoint.
steps.alt: CLI terminal showing a successful private GetObject with redacted identifiers. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Download an object over the private path.

steps.title: Confirm S3 request metrics in CloudWatch
steps.description: Open the bucket request metrics. GetRequests should increment after the private copy. Use this as architecture verification rather than a screenshot of secrets.
steps.alt: CloudWatch metric widget for S3 GetRequests after the private copy. Redacted AWS Console snapshot for Confirm S3 request metrics in CloudWatch.
steps.cliFallback: aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/S3 --metric-name GetRequests --dimensions Name=BucketName,Value=academy-lab-artifacts Name=FilterId,Value=EntireBucket --start-time 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-01-01T01:00:00Z --period 300 --statistics Sum

skipGates.prompt: Write a gateway endpoint policy that allows s3:GetObject only when aws:SourceVpce matches the lab endpoint, and explain why a NAT gateway is unnecessary for S3-only private workloads.
